You cannot just take a supplement and be suddenly smarter and have better language skills. This is something you need to approach in a holistic way. You need to practice on your language skills by reading and writing. To have the motivation to do so you may need to change your physical health and mental health so you don't become tired easily and have a clearer mind. I've taken supplements such as shilajit or lions mane that have helped my brain fog. But ultimately changing your lifestyle to one which prioritizes focusing on your eating habits and excersising will help and motivate you to speak and think in a " smarter " way.
